question: Which article of the Constitution of India guarantees the right to constitutional remedies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 32**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 32** of the Constitution of India guarantees the right to constitutional remedies.
 
• This article is a fundamental right that allows individuals to move the Supreme Court (and High Courts) to seek enforcement of other fundamental rights.
 
• Dr. B.R. Ambedkar referred to Article 32 as the "heart and soul" of the Constitution because it ensures the protection of fundamental rights.
 
• Under Article 32, the Supreme Court is empowered to issue writs, including habeas corpus, mandamus, prohibition, quo warranto, and certiorari, to enforce the rights.
 
• It reflects the importance placed on judicial review and the protection of individual rights within the Indian legal framework.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 32** is part of Part III of the Constitution, which deals with Fundamental Rights.
 
• Part III spans Articles 12 to 35, covering various rights like equality, freedom, exploitation, religion, culture, and education.
 
• Article 32 cannot be suspended except by the procedure prescribed by the Constitution, making it a critical element of the Indian judicial system.
 
• Other articles in Part III also provide specific protections, but Article 32 provides the means to enforce them.
 
• This article ensures that the judiciary acts as a guardian of the Constitution and the fundamental rights of the citizens.
